title: Pasolini
description: Case notes on the Pasolini General Contractor site — ribbon-mark hero, a 500-row client ledger and 360° tour links built on Stra Studio’s identity system
summary: Cultural archive with deep-zoom scans, timeline state encoded in the URL
notes: Art direction is straight out of Stra Studio’s identity work — the layered ribbon P in signal orange over four greys, ported to the hero as one layered SVG and themed through two custom properties so no other block carries a colour of its own

notes.lead: What Stra Studio handed over, dropped into the build unchanged
items: ribbon P mark as one layered SVG with the five identity greys as tokens
service photography locked to their 3:2 sell-sheet crop
the 1959 DITTA L. archive plate supplied as a single signed scan

notes: Below 900px the page recomposes instead of shrinking — the ribbon stacks under the claim, the pillar cards go full bleed and the client ledger reflows to one row per client with its image and tour badges inline

The client ledger runs 500+ entries as one progressively disclosed table — rows expand in place for the project shots, the Immagini and Tour Virtuale columns are real links instead of lightbox chrome and every brand name stays plain text for search

Each virtual tour card deep-links into a 360° panorama of the finished store, and design reviews ran on shared staging with Stra Studio — three focused rounds, art direction notes closed per section and the approved state frozen before the client roster went into the CMS

Since launch the marketing team adds client rows and tour links on their own and the marchio storico announcement landed on the same layout with no rebuild — the kind of outcome that gets a general contractor asking about the next site before the invoice clears
